title: The sync gate runs perfcheck ids --against the test id baseline when a test file changes
goal: Retrospective of SP-yzs3bj6f: ST-urfa4ntj renamed a land e2e test and left _tools/test_ids_baseline.txt naming the old id, which only a manual perfcheck.py ids --against run showed (BG-mxptguxo, found by a later review); the sync gate runs perfcheck.py dropped but not ids --against. When a landing changes a _tools/test_*.py file, kbgit.py sync --push runs perfcheck.py ids --against _tools/test_ids_baseline.txt and fails on a MISSING id, naming the baseline line to update.

run: import sys; sys.exit(0 if 'ids --against' in open('_tools/kg_sync.py',encoding='utf-8').read() else 1)
